instruction: Set the editor font size to 18 in VS Code settings.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully installed autoDocstring extension by opening Extensions panel (Ctrl+Shift+X), searching 'autoDocstring', and clicking Install. Completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VS Code UI, use keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+X), search extensions marketplace, locate and click Install buttons, interact with Settings panel
metadata.task_rationale: Different VS Code operation: changing settings instead of installing extensions. The trajectory showed the agent can interact with VS Code Settings panel (visible in screenshot 0), so navigating to font size setting is a related challenge.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing editor font size to 18. Evaluator reads settings.json via vscode_config getter and checks editor.fontSize equals 18.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter vscode_config correctly retrieves settings.json by opening VS Code command palette with 'Preferences: Open Settings (JSON)' and downloading the file from the correct path /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json

Metric check_json_settings correctly handles the rule-type expected parameter: get_rule returns {"expected": {"editor.fontSize": 18}}, and the metric accesses expected['expected'] to get the key-value pairs to check
The metric iterates over expected key-value pairs and verifies each exists in the actual settings JSON with the correct value, which is the right logic for verifying editor.fontSize == 18
Complete coverage: the instruction has a single requirement (set editor font size to 18) and the evaluator fully verifies it

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
